data.name: Kaushalya
data.gender_notes: Kaushalya is used as a female name in hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Sanskrit kuśala, 'skilful, competent' — Kausalyā. Its root is Sanskrit kuśala (कुशल). Kaushalya, mother of Rama in the Ramayana. Kaushalya is a Sanskrit name meaning “Skilful; (also) of the Kosala kingdom”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.
data.spiritual_meaning: Kaushalya expresses “Skilful; (also) of the Kosala kingdom”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.etymology: From the Sanskrit kuśala, 'skilful, competent' — Kausalyā.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Kaushalya total 27, reducing to 9. Number 9 is associated with compassion, idealism and completion.

faq.a: The Pythagorean lucky number for Kaushalya is 9 (ruling planet Mars). This is an interpretive association, not a factual claim.

faq.a: Tuesday is the traditional association for Kaushalya. This is interpretive.
